consent.intro: Please read and accept the following to use the Bakery Management System.
consent.dataStorageText: Your recipes, ingredients, orders, and shopping lists are stored securely in our database and are only accessible with your account. We do not share your data with third parties.
consent.personalDataText: We store your email address to identify your account. You can request deletion of your account and all associated data at any time by contacting the account owner.
consent.cookiesText: We use a session cookie to keep you signed in. No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
consent.checkboxLabel: I have read and agree to the above. I understand how my data is stored and used within this system.
consent.footer: You only need to accept once. This will not be shown again.

outcome.intro: Right now, Shopify orders only show up in your Planner if you remember to click 'Import orders.' After this setup, every new order arrives within seconds of the customer placing it.
outcome.reRunIntro: Your webhook is already set up. Re-running setup replaces your signing secret — useful if you've rotated it in Shopify or if something has stopped working.
outcome.change1: Orders appear automatically — you don't have to do anything
outcome.change2: Orders that match a recipe get scheduled for production
outcome.change3: Orders with unfamiliar products stay as 'pending' for review
outcome.requirements: About 10 minutes. You'll need access to your Shopify admin.
outcome.reRunRequirements: About 5 minutes. You'll need access to your Shopify admin.

openShopify.title: Open your Shopify admin
openShopify.body: Open Shopify in a new tab and go to <settings>Settings</settings> → <notifications>Notifications</notifications>.

createWebhook.title: Create the webhook
createWebhook.step1: Scroll to the bottom of the Notifications page and click <create>Create webhook</create>.

pasteUrl.title: Paste the URL
pasteUrl.body: Paste this <webhook>webhook URL</webhook> into the <url>URL</url> field in Shopify, then click <save>Save</save>.
pasteUrl.webhookHint: A webhook URL is the address Shopify will send each new order to — like a mailbox for instant notifications.

pasteSecret.title: Paste the signing secret
pasteSecret.body: Shopify just showed you a <secret>signing secret</secret>. Copy it now — Shopify only shows it <once>once</once>.
pasteSecret.secretHint: A signing secret is a private code Shopify uses to prove that incoming orders really came from your shop and weren't sent by someone else.

test.title: Test the connection
test.intro: Almost done. Place a test order in Shopify — we'll watch for it here and confirm everything's wired up.
test.skip: Skip — I'll test with a real order

done.title: Setup complete
done.intro: From now on, new Shopify orders appear in your Planner automatically. Auto-scheduled when products match a recipe; otherwise they sit as 'pending' for your review.
done.worthKnowing1: This doesn't sync inventory back to Shopify — that's a separate setting in Settings → Shopify.
done.worthKnowing2: You still fulfil and ship from Shopify itself; this only pulls orders in.
done.worthKnowing3: If something stops working, come back to Settings → Shopify to re-run setup.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.subtitle: Live timing data for tRPC procedures and the database. Helps pinpoint why pages occasionally hang or fail to load.
diagnostics.confirmClearServer: Delete all server-side metric rows? This cannot be undone.

probe.title: Database health probe
probe.description: Runs SELECT 1 three times in a row. The first call shows cold-start latency; later calls show the warm baseline.
probe.hint: If call #1 is slow but #2 and #3 are fast, the database was cold. If all three are slow, the bottleneck is elsewhere (network, auth, or the DB itself is overloaded).

server.title: Slow & failed queries (last 24h)
server.description: Captured server-side. Only procedures slower than 1500 ms or that errored are logged.
server.empty: No slow or failed queries in the last 24 hours.

recent.title: Recent slow/failed log
recent.description: Most recent 100 entries from the server log.

client.title: This browser — per procedure
client.description: End-to-end timings observed from this device, including network. Captures every query, fast or slow.
client.empty: No queries logged yet from this browser.

clientRecent.title: This browser — recent queries
clientRecent.description: Most recent 50 queries fired from this device.
